course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Posting and unposting: separate documents from movements
goal: Add a teaching labor-turnover register in a copy and verify ordinary writing, posting and unposting for one own recorder.

prerequisites.text: onec.p4; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: The document is the recorder
paragraphs: A movement explains which document caused an accounting fact. A service desk can track minute obligations by customer. A record contains period, dimensions, resource and recorder. A document’sMinutes field is not itself a movement. Agree on sign and meaning before implementing a handler.

Posting is denied in the starter. In a new copy add accumulation register Трудозатраты with Turnovers kind, Клиент: CatalogRef.Клиенты dimension and Минуты: Number(15,2) resource. The existing document attribute remains ДлительностьМинут. The register resource is a distinct field; no populated header attribute must be renamed.

sections.title: Three states of one recorder
paragraphs: The real query filters a single recorder using the Заявка parameter.

sections.title: Rebuild the movement set
paragraphs: Build movements from current document data inPosting and control record-set writing. Reposting replaces that recorder’s effect rather than appending a duplicate. Changing 30 to 45 yields 45, not 75. Do not manually add the prior document amount to the new record set.

Allow document posting and select Трудозатраты among its register records. In ОбработкаПроведения clear this recorder’s collection, enable writing and add period from Дата, customer from Клиент and minutes from ДлительностьМинут. This clears the current document’s movement set, not the whole register. Keep the existing ПередЗаписью validation.

sections.title: Reversal removes effects, not the document
paragraphs: After reversal, the document remains while its accounting effect is removed or compensated under the model. Metadata and handlers determine behavior. Inspect recorder-filtered records and register totals, not onlyPosted. A starter stand without posting needs a new versioned template for this exercise.

The function creates an own 30-minute request. An ordinary write gives zero movements filtered by its reference. Posting gives one row and 30 minutes. Unposting with automatic movement deletion removes those rows while retaining the document and reference. Новая is not a posting criterion. Test one recorder rather than the entire infobase’s accumulated total.

sections.title: Correct mechanism, incorrect value
paragraphs: Row count and resource value are separate claims.

code.output: One movement does not prove the expected 30 minutes.

sections.title: Rejection must be atomic
paragraphs: If required movement data is missing, reject before accepting effects. A negative case checks both document and movements. An unset flag with partially modified register data is not a correct rejection. Transactional checks cover every side effect, not one table alone.

The incorrect variant uses 31 minutes: it still creates a movement, but the independent 30-minute expectation rejects it. Do not adjust expected totals to follow a defect. This small teaching model does not establish statutory accounting, concurrent posting, reservation or industrial performance. Reposting is developed in the next module.
